The simulation results show that with the increase of trap density, the electric field distribution inside the material has a similar change trend, but the charge migration speed gradually slows down; the decrease of the trapping coefficient and the increase of the detrapping coefficient will accelerate the migration of the charge; the temperature difference on the electrode The existence of, the charge injected on the high-temperature side becomes the dominant charge; when the polarity is reversed, the injection of electrons and holes at both ends of the medium is also reversed, and the degree of charge change increases with the increase of the voltage after the reversal.

articleTitle: Coordinated Droop Control for Hybrid HVDC with Cascaded Multi-Infeed VSC Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The hybrid HVDC with cascaded VSC will be put into reality soon in China. To research its control characteristic and enhance the stabilities, the adaptive droop control is proposed for VSC inverters and a hierarchical coordinated adaptive strategy is designed, which are realized through three parts. The first coordinated strategy is to maintain the inverter side DC voltage in constant by shifting the VSC inverters’ droop curves, such that the operation variation will not change the DC voltage in droop control, where the power transferred by the hybrid HVDC would be varied if voltage deviation occurs; the second is to realize VSC inverters’ accurate power control for practical project and power dispatch, which is through the droop control reference adjustment. Based on the above coordinated strategies. The simulation results validate theory finally.

articleTitle: Research on Sliding Mode Control of An Active Magnetic Bearing High-Speed Motor Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the improvement of high-speed motor technical requirements, the PID-controlled Active Magnetic Bearings (AMB)-rotor system gradually shows its shortcomings. In this regard, this paper proposes to use sliding mode controller (SMC) to constrain the magnetic bearing. Based on the introduction of the AMB structure, this paper establishes a mathematical model of a single-degree-of-freedom(DOF) magnetic suspension rotor system, and designs PID control and SMC schemes respectively according to the mathematical model. According to the prototype parameters, the approach rate of SMC was selected, and a simulation model was built on the Simulink platform, simulation experiments were carried out for the step response and sudden disturbance of the system. Comparing the displacement output of the rotor under PID control and SMC, it can be found that the AMB high-speed motor rotor system under SMC can achieve stable suspension operation, and the system under SMC has better anti-interference ability and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Speed Estimation from a Low-Resolution Encoder Using Adaptative Extend Kalman Observer in Low-Speed Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The position update time increases when the motor with a low-resolution position encoder runs at a low speed. Therefore, a considerable speed calculation delay is generated, and the bandwidth of the speed controller is limited. This paper proposes an adaptive extended Kalman observer, which observes the motor speed and position information through the encoder pulse output and current sampling, and updates the position measurement noise variance in real-time to reduce the motor position and speed estimation error. It is compared with the standard Kalman observer, and the superiority of the proposed adaptive extended Kalman observer is verified through simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Parameter Design Method for SS Compensated Dynamic Wireless Transfer System Considering Coils’ Parameters Variations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: For automatic guided vehicles with dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT), the vertical variation in the height of the pickup coil is inescapable due to load variations. It can cause changes in the system coil parameters (self-inductances and mutual inductance), further affecting the stability of the system output power. To realize a stable output of the DWPT system when the height of the pickup coil is variable, a parameter design method is proposed in this paper. A mathematical model of output power is established considering the vibrations of coil parameters. The influences of the compensation circuit on the output power and the input impedance are analyzed. The fluctuation of the output power is limited with the circuit parameter optimization. Finally, a 1-kW prototype is built to verily the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Experimental results indicate that within the gap range (20mm~40mm), the maximum fluctuation of the designed system output power is only 4.39% even if the self-inductances vary by 12.33uH and 27.9uH, respectively, and the mutual inductance changes by 1.45 times. Furthermore, the lowest efficiency of the system can reach 91.73%

articleTitle: Economic Analysis on Photovoltaic System Operation of Fujian
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Economic analysis is performed in this paper for Photovoltaic (PV) system operation based on the reality of Fujian power system. Firstly, the basic condition of PV system in Fujian is illustrated and the future development trend is also discussed. Secondly, two typical operation modes of PV system are introduced, namely the “self occupied, margin online” (SOMO) and the “distributed PV + energy storage system” (PV+ESS). Thirdly, the mathematical model of economic analysis for PV operation is proposed for two typical modes, respectively. Finally, a case study is conducted to evaluate the economic characteristic of PV operation mode for different voltage level system. It is illustrated by numerical results that the benefit of SOMO mode is reasonable under current policy while the PV+ESS mode is less beneficial considering the high investment cost of ESS. However, the benefit of PV+ESS mode is substantial with the decrease of ESS cost, which is a promising trend for future development of electric distribution system.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of the Composite JA Hysteresis Model Based on Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The Jlies-Atherton (JA) hysteresis model has the advantages of few model parameters and clear physical meanings, which is widely used in the hysteresis simulations. However, the classic JA models consider little about the complicated losses during the excitation and demagnetization process. In addition, it is hard for existing parameter identification algorithms to meet the needs of the model establishment. This paper proposed a composite JA hysteresis simulation model considering the excitation loss, eddy current loss, and additional loss. The whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is used in the parameter identification of the model to increase accuracy and reliability. The hysteresis measurement module was used to measure the hysteresis loops, which were used to be the learning materials for the optimization algorithm. The simulation and test results were in good agreement and had a similarity of 97.36%, which proved the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Series-Parallel Resonance-Switched-Capacitor Equalizer for the Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Cascade Utilization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The hybrid energy storage system (HESS) uses the retired power battery can prolong the battery life cycle and lower the system’s cost. A series-parallel resonance switched-capacitor equalizer for the HESS is proposed in this paper, which uses series-parallel resonance switched-capacitor to realize the balance. In addition, the use of series-parallel resonance circuits can realize the conversion of different voltage levels, and energy can flow through the HESS via equalizer. Therefore, the entire HESS only needs one equalization circuit to achieve system equalization. Moreover, a prototype consisting of a ternary-lithium battery pack, a polymer-lithium battery pack and a supercapacitor pack is built.

articleTitle: Protection scheme of offshore wind power AC submarine cable based on correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Affected by the access of power electronic equipment and the distributed capacitance of the submarine cable, the traditional differential protection is difficult to fully protect the offshore wind power AC submarine cable line. Therefore, a protection scheme of offshore wind power AC submarine cable based on relevant principles is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the correlation difference between line differential current and braking current is used to form a protection criterion. On this basis, the influence of distributed capacitive current of submarine cable line on correlation was analyzed. Then, by normalizing the current amplitude on both sides, the ability of the protection scheme to withstand capacitive current was improved. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed protection is verified by simulation. The simulation results show that when the length of the submarine cable line is 150km with no compensation, the proposed protection scheme can still operate correctly within 5ms.

articleTitle: A High Step-Down Buck-Boost Converter Based on Coupled Inductor With Wide Input Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In data center application, the bus converter not only needs to achieve high step-down gain but also keep a high efficiency when the bus voltage changes in a wide range. A high step-down buck-boost converter based on tapped inductor in this paper is presented. Due to the tapped inductor, the proposed possesses high step-down conversion capability. Moreover, when input voltage changes greatly, the duty cycle of the converter can be controlled to a suitable range and hence maintain a high efficiency. The theoretical analysis is verified by prototype with a wide input voltage (36-60V), 3. 3V output voltage, and rated output current 10A.

articleTitle: A Modified Multi-objective FCS-MPC for the IPMSM with MTPA Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a modified control strategy of Finite-Control-Set Model Predictive Control (FCS-MPC) for the Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (IPMSM) is proposed to solve the problem that the actual stator current cannot quickly track the given Maximum Torque Per Ampere (MTPA) current due to the integration saturation of the current regulator caused by sudden changes in load torque. The FCS-MPC controller is used to replace the PI current regulator, to obtain a more accurate voltage vector and achieve real-time dynamic tracking of the IPMSM MTPA target trajectory. The cost function of FCS-MPC control strategy is designed multi-objective combination to meet such requirements: torque tracking, MTPA current tracking and limitation of the maximum current. The simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control strategy can track the MTPA given current and torque in real time during load torque sudden changes.

articleTitle: Grid-Voltage Extraction for Grid-Connected Power Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The timely and accurate extraction of the grid-voltage is essential to the normal operation of the grid-connected converter. The phase-locked loop based on the synchronous reference frame (SRF-PLL) does not have fast response and superior filtering performance at the same time, so it cannot be applied to the applications of non-ideal power grid. By adding some high-order notch filters (NF) on the q-axis of SRF-PLL, a new algorithm called NFSRF-PLL is proposed, which can effectively filter out harmonics while ensuring that the response time is the same as that of SRF-PLL. In addition, for LVRT applications, based on the theory of coordinate transformation, a simple and effective method for detecting the grid-voltage sag-depth is also designed. By adding a second-order notch filter and a low-pass filter to the dq axis, the fundamental negative-sequence components and higher harmonics can be suppressed, respectively. At the same time, the bandwidth of the low-pass filter can be set relatively high. Therefore, the detection method has the characteristics of fast detection speed, high detection accuracy and good robustness. Finally, experimental comparison results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Ultrasonic Signal Detection in Transformer Bushing Based on Mach-Zehnder Fiber Optic Interferometer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Oil-impregnated paper (OIP) bushings are widely used in the power system. In order to detect the weak signal generated by the partial discharge (PD) in bushing online, a fiber-optic ultrasonic sensing system based on Mach-Zehnder interference (MZI) was studied in this paper. The average sensitivity of the OFS is 67.3 dB(0dB=1V(m$\cdot \mathrm{s}^{-1}$)). The performance test of the fiber-optic ultrasonic sensor (OFS) was carried out on a real 110 kV transformer bushing. PD signal was detected by the proposed MZI fiber-optic ultrasonic sensor, when the average discharge volume is 10.4 pC. The experimental results show that the interferometric fiber-optic ultrasonic sensing system can be used for transformer bushing PD ultrasonic signal detection. It is of great significance to improve the maintenance of the transformer bushing.

articleTitle: Unbalance suppression method for the output voltage of three-phase four-wire energy-storage inverter based on weighting control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Since the three-phase four-wire energy storage inverter can operate with the single-phase load and can also compensate for unbalanced voltage in island mode, it is adopted widely. However, due to the existence of the neutral line, the way to solve imbalance problem is more complicated. For this reason, this paper proposes the unbalance weighting control (UWC), which can suppress the unbalanced voltage by weighting controlling the negative- and zero-sequence voltages at the point of common coupling (PCC). Compared with the existing anti-unbalance control strategies, the proposed method directly suppresses the unbalanced voltage, which is simpler and more effective. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: A Compact Non-resonant Capacitive Power Transfer System without Compensation Inductor for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel non-resonant CPT system for low power applications. Compared to the traditional resonant or non-resonant CPT system, the proposed CPT system lacks a compensation inductor which is attractive to make the CPT system more compact and simpler. The proposed circuit is present, and a detailed analysis is given. The analysis results show that the proposed system can achieve a wild output gain by changing the switching frequency. A simulation model based on Simulink/MATLAB is built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed system. The simulation results agree well with the calculation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vibration Signal Caused by DC Bias at Different Measuring Points of Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Power transformer is easy to be invaded by the stray current of urban rail transit, resulting in DC bias. Then the DC bias will lead to severe vibration of the transformer. By analyzing the characteristics of the surface vibration signal of the transformer, whether the transformer is invaded by the stray current can be judged. In this paper, the time domain and frequency spectrum information of vibration signals of six measuring points of 220kV transformer are summarized and compared. Finally, it is concluded that for the 220kV transformer, among the 6 selected measuring points, when the neutral current changes, the vibration signal of the center point of transformer box surface of intermediate phase changes most obviously. Hence, for 220kV transformer, the center point of transformer box surface of intermediate phase is the most suitable for measuring vibration signals caused by DC bias.

articleTitle: A Non-isolated High Step-up DC-DC Converter Based on Coupled Inductor and Switched Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a high step-up dc-dc converter for the renewable energy system. The coupled inductor and switched capacitor techniques are used to boost the high voltage gain. Due to the leakage inductance energy is recycled, the efficiency is improved and the voltage stress of the power switch is clamped. Moreover, a comparison with other revealed converter is analyzed and the proposed converter has higher conversion ratio. In addition, to enhance the conversion ratio, the circuit of the proposed converter can be simply extended. Finally, a simulation experiment with input voltage of 24 V, output voltage of 312 V, and wattage rating of 312 W is implemented to validate the correctness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Auto Disturbance Rejection Control of Unified Power Quality Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Nowadays, the complex structure of power system and the diversification of power load continue to cause power quality problems. Traditional power conditioning devices cannot continuously adjust transient power quality problems. Therefore, a Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) Continuously adjust power quality issues such as drops and harmonics. This article takes UPQC as the research object, introduces its basic structure and working principle, harmonic detection technology, tracking control technology, and determines the control strategy on both sides of the series and parallel connections; secondly, introduces the principle, advantages and disadvantages of PI control, and introduces this article The research content of Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) replaces PI control to maintain the voltage on the DC side of the UPQC. The principle and structure are introduced, the design method of linear ADRC is introduced in detail, the first-order linear active disturbance rejection controller adapted to the DC side of UPQC is built, and the simulation results are obtained.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Impedance Modeling of Grid-tied Converters Governed by PWM Saturation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The existing researches focus only on the linearized impedance model and the impedance-based stability issues. However, since there also exist many nonlinear components in control loops, their nonlinear dynamics are also needed to be accounted in some way for improving the modeling accuracy. To solve this problem, an impedance model with taking the saturation nonlinearity of Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) into consideration is developed in this paper. It represents this nonlinearity using a series of saturation gains and works out their explicit expressions via the describing-function theory. By incorporating the resulting saturation gains to the existing small-signal impedance expressions, a partly nonlinear impedance model can be achieved to reflect perturbation dynamics. Theoretical results and electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations have both verified its effectiveness. Quantitative analyses indicate that it is PWM saturation that dominates the overall nonlinearity, but this dominance may be challenged by larger PLL bandwidths or higher perturbation magnitudes.

articleTitle: Concept Design of BU for Mesh-like Constant Current Seafloor Observation Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Cabled undersea observation networks have been attracting increasing research attention due to the abilities of abundant power distribution and broad bandwidth communication. Stability of their power supply systems is crucial for their normal operation. However, rare studies were carried out on constant current (CC) mesh-like undersea observation networks. This paper focuses on designing branching unit (BU) for CC mesh-like seafloor observation network. Firstly, the design concept of CC mesh-like submarine power system is introduced, as well as the equivalent model of power delivery submarine cable and the circuit of CC converters. Then, based on features of the power network, concept of BU for mesh-like CC system is proposed respectively, and reliability protection schemes for various scenarios are analyzed. The model of the observatory network was set in MATLAB, Simulations were carried out, from which results showed good consistence, verifying the theoretical methods.

articleTitle: Crosstalk Analysis and Suppression of Silicon Carbide MOSFET based Three-level Neutral-Point-Clamped Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the gate-source characteristic of Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFET in Three-level Neutral-Point Clamped (3L-NPC) Inverter. To analyze the switching process of the SiC MOSFET, the bridge arm crosstalk and gate voltage oscillation phenomenon of the 3L-NPC, the mathematical model of the cross-talk voltage based on 3L-NPC is introduced. The switching period of the SiC devices is analyzed which include the crosstalk and parasitic oscillation. According to this, the snubber circuit and the gate voltage surge suppression circuit are designed, which also include overcurrent and overvoltage protection. The experiment shows good results of the proposed analyzes. And the conclusion can be extended to multilevel Inverter.

articleTitle: Formation and Diffusion Characteristics of Carbon Black in Insulating Oil Under Multiple Breakdown
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The particle size generation characteristics of carbon black particles during breakdown arc under AC voltage have important influence on insulation performance and repetitive breakdown voltage. In order to obtain the effect of arc energy after breakdown on the particle size generation and breakdown characteristics of carbon black particles, a carbon black particle test platform based on multi-parameter observation was built. The influence of oil gap distance and setting time on breakdown voltage was analyzed. The results show that the particle size of carbon black particles after breakdown of insulating oil is mainly between 5μm-50μm. With the increase of breakdown voltage, the arc energy increases, the carbon black particles increase and the proportion of carbon black particles increases. It is found that the larger the arc energy, the more favorable the formation of large particle size particles, and the stronger the trigger discharge ability of large particle size particles, which will lead to the obvious decrease of breakdown voltage in repetitive breakdown test. Increasing the setting time is helpful to the diffusion of carbon black particles and reduces the effect on breakdown voltage.

articleTitle: Modified DFIG Convertor Control Strategy for High Voltage Ride Through
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Currently, wind power penetration is increased, and chain failures caused by DC blocking expose wind turbines to greater risk of high voltage ride-through (HVRT). In this paper, a modified HVRT strategy for rotor-side and grid-side converter of doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs) is proposed. A reactive power control strategy based on voltage bias is proposed for the grid-side converter (GSC) to maintain the DC-link voltage. To support the recovery of grid voltage after voltage dip, a modified control strategy for DFIG’s rotor side converter is proposed. A model of the grid-connected wind farm is built in MATLAB/Simulink to test the feasibility of the proposed method. Without adding additional hardware, the proposed strategy can ensure that the DC-link voltage does not exceed the limit during HVRT process of the wind turbine, and DFIG can absorb a certain amount of inductive reactive power to support the grid voltage recovery. Simulation results show that the proposed method improves the high voltage ride- through capability of DFIG under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Analysis of Multiple-Output DC-DC Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Multi-output DC-DC converters have simulated widespread interest considering some advantages such as plain circuit configuration, low cost and high conversion efficiency, which are incomparable with conventional multi-output technology. The purpose of this paper is to study the topology derivation approach of non-isolated multi-output DC-DC converters. Firstly, two types of basic output cells named voltage-type output cell (VOC) and current-type output cell (COC) are extracted from six basic dc-dc converters. According to the circuit principle and the duality principle, the topology structures of parallel-type VOC, series-type VOC, parallel-type COC and series-type COC are proposed. Secondly, a systematic derivation approach for multi-output converters is introduced. Furthermore, taking a proposed dual-output SEPIC converter derived from series-type VOC as an example, the operating principle, static and DCM characteristics of the proposed converter is studied. Finally, experiments have been carried out, which demonstrate the validity of the proposed topology derivation approach.

articleTitle: An Approach of Stator Flux Trajectory Tracking Control Based on Optimal PWM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In the medium and high voltage power drive system, in order to reduce the switching losses at a tolerable level, the switching frequency must be reduced to hundreds of Hertz. The synchronous optimal pulsewidth modulation method can meet the requirements of low current harmonic distortion at low switching frequency. Based on the off-line optimal pulse method, a closed-loop flux trajectory tracking control method which shifts the optimal pulse on-line to compensate the error is proposed in this paper. This method combines the selected harmonic elimination PWM (SHEPWM), which is used to reconstruct the reference flux and realizes the stator flux trajectory tracking with the full order observer. The real-time pulse pattern change strategy is adopted to eliminate the system dynamic modulation error and realize the high-performance control at low switching frequency. The simulation results on the neutral point clamped three-level inverter asynchronous motor control system prove the effectiveness of the stator flux trajectory tracking control strategy, which meets the requirements of low current harmonic distortion, low sensitivity of parameter and fast dynamic response at 280 Hz.

articleTitle: Effects of plasma current density profile on minor disruption in disruption simulations of J-TEXT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Experimental and theoretical researches of disruption mitigation were conducted in J-TEXT to explore the mechanism of disruptions and the method of mitigation. Among this researches, minor/major disruption was studied by numerical simulations. For the sake of comprehending the effects of plasma current density profile on minor disruption profoundly, simulations of supersonic molecular beam injection(SMBI) of impurities(argon) into J-TEXT with different distributions of plasma current density profile are conducted by NIMROD, a 3D magnetohydrodynamic(MHD) code. In this paper, different distributions of current density profile are realized by changing the safety factor to change the current density gradients. The result indicates that the distribution of the current density profile can affect MHD behaviors, which have a significant impact on minor disruption.

articleTitle: The Engineering Practical Calculation Method of Circulating Current in YD-connected Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The circulating current in the D-winding may cause primary current waveform distortion, and the reliability of the restraint criterion based on the typical magnetizing inrush current characteristics will be affected. The magnetizing inrush current with typical characteristics is the sum of primary current and circulating current. Using the circulating current to compensate the primary current can improve the reliability of the differential protection. When the phase is not saturated, the magnetizing inrush current is about zero. Therefore, the primary current of unsaturated phase can be replaced by the opposite of the circulating current. Based on this, an engineering practical calculation method for circulating current is proposed. In the method, the segmented primary currents are used to replace the circulating current. Phasor analysis is used to demonstrate the application effect of this method when remanence coefficients are different. The method is simple and practical, and has strong applicability and high reliability. Simulation and recorded waveforms have verified the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An Improved Linear Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) with notch Pre-filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Phase/frequency jumps, and harmonic pollution are important factors that affect accuracy of phase-locked loop (PLL) in weak grids. The synchronous reference frame PLL(SRF-PLL) is nonlinear and cannot balance dynamic response and harmonic filtering performance, which is difficult to meet the requirements in weak grids. To solve this problem, a pre-filter Feedforward Linear PLL (PFL-PLL) is proposed in this paper, which eliminates the nonlinearity and the effect of the voltage amplitude by direct phase recognition. The linear property of PLL makes it possible that take a feedforward path to improve the dynamic response. Meanwhile, a notch pre-filter and corresponding phase compensation module is designed to improve the dynamic response and accuracy of phase jump. In experiment, the proposed PLL could track the phase jump in half cycle and frequency jump in one cycle. The experiment results demonstrate that the proposed PFL-PLL is, which is a valuable phase-locked method in weak grid.

articleTitle: A Numerical Calculation Method of the Stray Capacitance of Potential Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The potential transformer (PT) is important in the power system simulations. The stray capacitance of the PT will make the power system prone to produce ferromagnetic resonance, and prone to cause abnormal port current rise during the induction withstand voltage test. Therefore, it is important to evaluate the stray capacitance of PT. This paper analyzed the winding structure of the PT in detail and evaluated the equivalent capacitance by calculating the electric field energy between the winding layers. The calculated results are in good agreement with the finite element simulations, which proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Cluster Resonance Suppression Strategy of Grid-Connected Inverter System based on Hybrid Impedance Shaping
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The harmonic stability of the multi-paralleled inverter system is essential under weak grid conditions. The grid side impedance may trigger the resonance phenomenon of the commonly used LCL filter. However, previous active damping strategies based on capacitor current feedback require extra sensors, resulting in higher economic costs. This paper proposes a scheme of hybrid impedance shaping for cluster resonance suppression of the paralleled grid-connected inverter system. From the perspective of the single inverter, the proposed method adopts sensorless active damping achieved by capacitor current estimation. From the standpoint of the paralleled inverter, the proposed scheme utilized the passive resistor with the switch to enhance the passivity of the system. Both of them reshape the impedances and improve the stability of the whole system. Theoretical analyses and experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed cluster resonance suppression strategy based on hybrid impedance shaping.

articleTitle: Development and Performance of Magnetic Gain Switch for Repetitive Pulsed Chemical Oxygen Iodine Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The magnetic gain switch is a promising pulse method to be applied in the repetitive pulsed chemical oxygen iodine laser (COIL). A new form of solid-state pulsed magnetic field system was proposed to construct a magnetic gain switch in this paper. The pulse magnet, pulse producing circuit, and control circuit are the three components of the system. Considering the actual application, the pulse magnet adopts an open structure with two symmetrical parts, and each part is composed of a coil and a permanent magnet. The pulse forming circuit topology is optimized for a specific load based on the pulse forming network (PFN), and an energy recovery circuit is also added to improve the repetitive frequency. Using the proposed solid-state pulsed magnetic field system, a 320 Hz rectangular magnetic field with a high field of not less than 405 gauss and a low field within ±10 gauss is generated in an area of $50*50*25 {\mathrm mm}^{3}$, and the rising and falling edges of the pulse are both 1.5 $\mu {\mathrm {s}}$.

articleTitle: Automatic Voltage Equalizer Based on Switched-Capacitor for Series-Connected Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The existing series-parallel switched-capacitor (SPSC) equalizers have a high voltage stress on switch, which reduces the reliability of the equalizer. To overcome this problem, an automatic voltage equalizer based on switched-capacitor for serial cells is proposed in this paper. In the proposed equalizer, the maximum switch-voltage-stress is significantly abated compared with existing SPSC equalizers, which enhances the equalization reliability. This proposed equalizer also shortens the length of equalization path between cells, which increases the speed of the equalizer. The equalization speed in this proposed equalizer is analyzed concretely, and design considerations are proposed. Simulation as well as experimental results are presented to verify the validity of this proposed equalizer.

articleTitle: State of Charge Balance of Distributed Batteries in DC Shipboard Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Electric ships have become popular for the purpose of reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving energy efficiency. The DC shipboard microgrid (SMG) provides a good solution to integrate the battery energy storage system (BESS), generators, electric propulsion system, and shipboard loads. In order to avoid over-discharging and over-charging of batteries and prolong the battery lifetime, it is necessary to balance the battery state-of-charge (SoC). This paper proposes a decentralized SoC balance method based on droop control in the DC SMG. The battery SoC balancing speed is regulated by an exponent parameter n, and larger n leads to faster SoC balance. In addition, the voltage drop caused by the proposed SoC-based droop control can be ensured within the allowed value in the entire SoC range. Verification of the proposed method is implemented in Matlab/Simulink model, which consists of two batteries. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensor-Less Control Based on SM-ADRC of PMLSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to improve the anti-disturbance and velocity response of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM) control system, sliding mode control (SMC) replaced proportion-differentiation (PD) controller in active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) in this paper. Simulation results show that sliding mode active disturbance rejection control (SM-ADRC) has better immunity to load disturbance and periodic disturbance than traditional ADRC and PI control at different reference velocities. In addition, SM-ADRC is also used in traditional permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), the simulations show that SM-ADRC also has good control effects. Finally linear state observer (LESO) combined with phase-locked loop (PLL) to estimates the speed signal of PMLSM to realize sensor-less control. The simulation results show that the speed estimation accuracy is high, and sensor-less speed closed-loop control can be realized. The comparison between sliding mode observer (SMO) and ESO shows that the rotor angle estimation error of ESO is smaller than that of SMO when the speed observation ability of SMO and ESO is the same. This proves that ESO is more suitable than SMO for sensorless control.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Diagnosis of Analog Circuit Fault Based on Neural Network Group
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a new hierarchical diagnosis method based on back propagation (BP) neural network group in analog circuit fault. This method realizes the diagnosis of soft fault and hard fault of analog circuit. Moreover, in order to improve the accuracy of automatic diagnosis, a preprocessing scheme of multi-feature parameter fusion is presented. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is used to calculate the DC component, fundamental amplitude, fundamental phase angle, amplitude of second harmonic, phase angle of second harmonic and distortion of the time domain output signal. Then these feature data are used as the input of neural network group. The diagnosis performance of this method is verified by the simulation and test of the triode single-stage amplifier circuit. Finally, the results show that this method performs well on fault diagnose. The accuracy of simulation diagnosis is up to 95%, and the accuracy of test is up to 90%.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Point Tracking Utilizing Golden Section Optimization for Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The paper introduces a novel Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) approach for Photovoltaic (PV) systems which is based on Golden Section Optimization (GSO). The approach finds the Maximum Power Point (MPP) by a method known as interval shrinking. Initially, two points were extracted from the known search space, then evaluated and a new point was generated accordingly. At the given iteration, according to the evaluation observations, the algorithm has a new narrowed interval bounded by the new point and one of the original points. When the interval is short enough, the algorithm begins iterating and the PV is required to run at the average value of the last discovered interval without disrupting either another voltage or the duty cycle. This thing makes the PV system converge easily to the MPP and around the highest Power Point without voltage or power oscillations, thus minimizing energy loss. The study reveals that, under quickly changing conditions and PV modules, the MPPT algorithm uses a few arithmetic operations and monitors the MPP of PV systems rapidly and accurately.

articleTitle: An Improved Backward/Forward Algorithm for Distribution Network Power Flow Calculation Considering Meteorological Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, an improved Backward/Forward sweep method for obtaining power flow is proposed with consideration of meteorological factors in distribution networks. In this method, the line resistance is treated as the temperature-dependent variable and an efficient method is proposed to estimate the line temperature at the beginning of the solving process. After that, the line temperature is updated by Taylor’s first-order approximation. The line temperature is used to update the line resistance in the improved Backward/Forward sweep (BFS) method. The simulation analysis on several distribution networks of different sizes shows that the proposed improved BFS method can improve the speed of distribution network power flow calculation when considering the meteorological factors.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Line Lightning Arrester Considering Terrain and Flashover Cost
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Line arrester is one of the most effective lightning protection methods for transmission lines. Conventional arrester installation methods do not consider the actual tower structure, terrain, and flashover cost, which leads to poor technical and economic efficiency and a certain degree of blindness. In order to study the economical installation plan of the arrester, based on the ATP-EMTP and electrical geometric model, the influence of the tower structure, topography and line flashover cost on the installation method of the double-circuit line arrester was studied. And use the technical and economic index W to comprehensively evaluate the lightning protection effect and economy of the arrester under different installation methods. When W>0, the installation of the arrester is economical. The larger the W value, the stronger the technical economy.

articleTitle: A High Misalignment Tolerant Inductive Power Transfer System Using Clamp Topology with Double-Solenoid Quadrature Pad
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Misalignment is an unavoidable problem in the inductive power transfer (IPT) system. In order to improve the stable output capacity of the IPT system under extreme offset, an approach based on the clamp topology is proposed. With the analysis of the clamp topology, a double-solenoid quadrature pad (DSQP) consisting of the double-solenoid coil and the square quadrature coil is presented. With the cooperation of clamp topology and DSQP, the IPT system can operate adaptively to realize stable output within a wide misalignment range. The misalignment performance and the design method of the proposed DSQP are elaborated, and a design example is given. Finally, A 500W prototype is implemented to verify the validity of the proposed method. The experimental results show that the fluctuation of dc output voltage is lower than 15% within 320mm (80%) misalignment with system efficiency at least 91.89%.

articleTitle: Design of a Quantized Current Tuning Device Based on Electron Accelerator Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As a novel method of realizing current quantization in electric metrology, the technique based on electron accelerators has attracted concentrations recently, because it is feasible to count electron bunches rather than single electrons. As the two critical issues, stable emission and transmission of the electron beams are of importance to promote the application of the accelerator techniques in the current quantization. Based on comprehensive reviews on an existing electron source containing system introduction and emission experiment, a current tuning device with a magnetic element is introduced in this context. By using electromagnetic simulations and beam dynamics calculations, the structures of the entire facility are designed and fabricated. According to the simulations and corresponding analysis, the device can be used to validate the method of current quantization via electron accelerators, and further verification experiments will be conducted in the near future.

articleTitle: Effects of Load on CVT Transient Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of load on the transient characteristics of capacitive voltage transformer is studied. The CVT secondary side generally has four windings, and the different loads of each winding on the secondary side will directly cause the CVT measurement error. Under the same transient overvoltage condition of the CVT input, the influence of different loads on the secondary output waveform of the CVT is measured, and a network analyzer is used to measure the scattering parameters in each case and convert it into a transfer function to analyze the results. The results show that at frequencies under 9kHz-50kHz, the measured waveform of the secondary side decreases with the increase of the load, and the change of $\cos\varphi=1$ is more obvious than the change of $\cos\varphi=0.8$. At the same time, the transfer function obtained by the measurement and calculation also decreases with the increase of the load.

articleTitle: Enhanced Switched Inductor Quasi Z-source Inverter Based on SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the application range of Z-source inverter, an enhanced switched inductor quasi Z-source inverter with high boost capability is proposed in this paper. By applying the switched inductor cascade technology to the switched inductor Z-source inverter and transforming its structure, It has higher boost capacity, lower capacitor voltage stress and certain ability to suppress start-up impact, so as to further strengthen the circuit stability. The working principle of the inverter proposed in this paper is analyzed and its performance is compared. In the aspect of control, space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technology is used to control it without increasing the number of switching actions. Matlab/Simulink software is used to simulate the proposed inverter to ensure its correctness and feasibility. Finally, the inverter is further verified by building an experimental platform.

articleTitle: Secondary Voltage Control of DC Distribution Network Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the voltage problems of DC distribution network with multiple groups of PV-Battery energy storage units, a distributed voltage secondary control strategy based on model predictive control algorithm is proposed in this paper. A multi-step prediction consistency model is designed as the voltage prediction model. The prediction coefficients are obtained by minimizing the objective function, contributing to the optimal secondary compensations which are added to the primary control. Deviation adjustment problems under the PI controller in traditional consistency algorithm are transformed into the voltage tracking problems under the model predictive controller. This method effectively solves the problems of poor transient characteristics of the traditional consistency algorithm and reduces control errors in some cases. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed strategy in different conditions have been verified by building a model on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reactive Power Optimization in Three-phase Unbalanced Distribution Network Considering the Flexible Support of PV Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Considering the unbalance property of distribution network and the flexible reactive power support of PV inverters, the dynamic reactive power optimization (DRPO) method which optimizes the PV reactive power output based on global information is proposed to improve the economy and safety of network operation. The traditional “Q-V” droop control method is improved and the flexible “Q-V” droop control model of PV inverter without dead zone is established. Moreover, based on three-phase unbalance power flow model, the DRPO model which aims to reduce power losses is constructed. The linearization method and stochastic programming (SP) theory are used to transfer the DRPO model into deterministic convex optimization model which is easy to solve. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method are verified by the numerical simulations on the IEEE 123-node test system.

articleTitle: A Non-intrusive Method Based on Deep Learning for Abnormal Electricity Consumption Detection of Electric Bicycles
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Abnormal electricity consumption of electric bicycles has given rise to many severe accidents (e.g., explosion and fire accidents). Primary causes of these accidents are users’ incorrect charging behavior and lack of stipulated safety standard designed for different charging devices. From utility’s perspective, it is of great importance to detect abnormal electricity consumption of electric bicycles in a non-intrusive way considering the customers’ privacy concern. Therefore, this paper proposed a non-intrusive method based on deep learning for abnormal electricity consumption detection of electric bicycles. Firstly, charging curve and charging process of electric bicycles are studied. Then customers’ electricity consumption data is analyzed, the missing values are filled in and the outliers are removed to prepare dataset. Afterwards, convolutional neural network (CNN) model is constructed and trained to identify the abnormal data. Finally, results of CNN model are compared with deep neural network (DNN) and other machine learning techniques in order to demonstrate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance Optimization and Simulation of Galvanometer Motor Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper deduces the general mathematical model of galvanometer motor. The parameters of galvanometer motor are given, which are applied to high-speed and high-precision occasions. And the characteristic‘s of the motor are analyzed. Then, the traditional three loop position control system is designed, and the dynamic performance and existing problems of the control system is researched. Aiming at the problem of dynamic tracking lag, this paper introduces feedforward control to realize non lag dynamic tracking, which is verified by simulation. In view of the contradiction between fast response and overshoot under step command, the transition process in galvanometer motor control system is arranged to realize tracking the position step command quickly without overshoot and oscillation, and the simulation is carried out to verify the mathematical model.

articleTitle: A Harmonic Current Suppression Method based on Repetitive Control for Twelve-phase PMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of multi-phase motors, when vector space decomposition (VSD) control is used, a small error voltage in the harmonic subspace will generate a large harmonic current, which leads to a large harmonic content of the motor currents. In the paper, repetitive current controllers are used to suppress the harmonic currents in the harmonic subspace, and the parameters of the controller obtained through mathematical derivation. The proposed method is verified by simulation, and the results show that this method can effectively suppress the harmonic currents of twelve-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM).

articleTitle: Calculation of Dielectric Loss of Oil-Paper Insulation Under Transient Voltages
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The increased dielectric loss is one of the comprehensive effects in insulating material from both the dielectric properties and the applied voltage, which causes the degradation of oil-paper (OIP) insulation especially when subjected to complex voltages. To quantitatively analyze the dielectric loss of OIP insulation, starting from the dielectric response characteristics of the bushing and the extended Debye model (EDM), the Runge-Kutta method is proposed to solve the EDM circuit. Taking four groups of measured waveforms of single type overvoltage and hybrid overvoltage as the typical instances of transient voltages, the active power loss of the OIP bushing is calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of Two-phase Hybrid Stepping Motor Based on Three-phase Inverter SPWM Control Strategy in Aircraft Refrigeration System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The new generation of aircraft refrigeration subsystem uses stepper motors to drive the servo valve as the drive source, and utilizes the holding torque and open loop control characteristics of the stepper motor when the stepper motor stops to meet requirements of aircraft for the controllability and reliability of the opening and closing angle of the servo valve. A two-phase hybrid stepping motor driven servo valve is selected as the research object. The motor control adopts the three-phase inverter SPWM control strategy. The topology saves about 25% power drive hardware. The test and simulation results show that the SPWM control strategy of the three-phase inverter can complete the micro-stepping control of the two-phase hybrid stepping motor perfectly. Especially when the motor works at a higher speed, it expands the application field of the electric drive servo valve and improves the control performance of the aircraft refrigeration subsystem.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformers Windings Deformation Based on Axial Vibration
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The stability of the mechanical structure of transformers plays an important role in the safe operation of entire power grid. As one of the common faults of transformers, minor winding deformation cannot be easily detected and its effects are cumulative. This paper focuses on vibration characteristics of transformer windings under deformation conditions to provide a basis for transformer fault diagnosis. We have developed a finite element model of a three-phase transformer to simulate and to calculate the distribution of winding electromotive force, based on which the winding deformation trend is predicted. We designed three types of deformation. The winding axial vibration signal characteristics were studied in detail under different degrees of deformation. The simulation results show that the maximum force is applied to both ends of the winding, meanwhile the high and low voltage windings are subjected to outward expansion force and inward compression force respectively. When the winding is deformed, the frequency distribution and amplitude of the vibration signal will be changed.

articleTitle: Study on Internal Characteristics of Converter Valve in DC Side Fault of True Bipolar MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Firstly, an improved detailed simulation model based on Thevenin equivalent is proposed to analyze the overvoltage and overcurrent of power electronic devices in MMC converter valve, which provides a new idea for converter valve level simulation of multi-level complex system. Then, the effects of different fault moments on the internal and external transient processes of MMC converter valve are explored. The results show that different fault moments will not affect the short-circuit current on the DC side, but have a great impact on the bridge arm current and overcurrent on power electronic devices. When the fault occurs at the voltage zero crossing of the AC side, the power electronic devices inside the converter valve will bear greater overcurrent threat. This provides theoretical basis and data support for fault transient simulation and protection of true bipolar mmc-hvdc system.

articleTitle: Research On Multi-objective Control Strategy of Dual-stage T-type Three-level Energy Storage Converter System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper describes the topology of dual-stage T-type three-level energy storage Power Conversion System (PCS), analyzes the control objectives under on-grid/off-grid conditions, and proposes a multi-objective control strategy based on dual-stage T-type three-level PCS. It also assigns the control strategy of the two-stage converter and the switching logic in the on-grid/off-grid switching process. An optimal control strategy of on-grid current/off-grid voltage waveform based on Vector Proportional integral (VPI) controller is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed control strategy achieves relevant control objectives and has good control effect.

articleTitle: Deformation of water surface with different metal-water discharge modes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The deformation of water surface with different modes of metal-water discharges are investigated by changing the ballast resistor of the electric circuit, the amplitude and polarity of the driven voltage. The discharge mode transforms among ‘DC glow’, ‘filaments’, ‘streamer corona’ and so on, which is different from metal-metal discharges. With the transformations of the discharge modes, the water surface deformation changes from the stable Taylor cone to the pulsing shaking or sink shapes. In addition, the water deformation can reflect the micro impact force of different modes of discharge which is difficult to detect. This investigation can be helpful for the application of the metal-water discharge.

articleTitle: Research on the Coupling Model and Optimal Operation of the Integrated Energy System with Hydrogen-Containing Heat Installation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The traditional cogeneration unit is constrained by “determining power by heat”, which has the problems of low operation efficiency and abandoning wind power. Therefore, the hydrogen heat device is introduced into the thermoelectric unit to realize the decoupling between the electric and thermal energy of the unit. Based on the analysis of its operation characteristics, the optimal dispatching model of power system containing hydrogen heat and wind power is established with the economic optimization as the objective function and verified by an example. The example shows that the hydrogen heating device can effectively improve the electrothermal characteristics of the unit in the low power load period, improve the peak shaving capacity of the multi-energy system, and expand the wind power grid space due to the unit operation constraint of “determining power by heat”, which is of great significance to improve the stable and economic operation of the whole power system.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Overvoltage Simulation and Protective Measures of 10kV Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The lightning disaster will directly invade into the 10kV/0.4kV distribution transformer installed on the line tower through the line, resulting in high overvoltage inside the transformer. Distribution transformer is an important part of the distribution network. Lightning current invades into the distribution transformer along overhead line, which will cause internal overvoltage and lead to insulation breakdown of high voltage side winding or low voltage side winding. In this paper, the broadband equivalent model of transformer is established, and the lightning overvoltage intrusion simulation of transformer is carried out. The changes of high voltage side voltage and low voltage side voltage of transformer are analyzed when the single-phase incoming wave of direct lightning and the three-phase incoming wave of induction lightning, and the corresponding protective measures are analyzed.

articleTitle: Self-triggering Fault Self-healing Test Based on Equivalence Class Division
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of incomplete testing of fault types, long fault cycle of point-by-point testing, and large test manual workload during the commissioning test of the fault self-healing function of the distribution network, a self- triggered fault self-healing test based on equivalence class division of fault points is proposed. Through model cross- section data restoration, automatic triggering of fault action equipment signals, and automatic verification of processing strategies, the automatic triggering, analysis and verification of faults at fault points are carried out. This method has the advantages of improving the test efficiency before the fault self- healing function is put into operation, comprehensive fault case test, reducing the manual simulation of fault action signal and manual judgment of test results, and improving the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Radio Interference of AC/DC Parallel Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The radio interference generation mechanism of AC-DC parallel transmission lines is different from that of conventional lines, so that the prediction model is either too rough and leads to large errors, or too complicated to be mastered by engineers. In order to take into account the accuracy of radio interference solution and engineering practicability, an error back-propagation feedforward neural network model combined with gray correlation theory is proposed. First, the gray theory screening of multiple impact indicators of radio interference, and then the indicators that have a real impact on radio interference as input variables, the BP neural network fitting algorithm is used to predict the radio interference. Validation combined with the actual measured radio interference samples of the AC-DC parallel transmission lines that have been put into operation, the results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the prediction accuracy of the BP neural network prediction model is improved by 14.6%.

articleTitle: Fire Ignition Mechanism and Extinguishing Method of Cable in High Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In recent years, several serious fire disasters have occurred in high-voltage switchgear. The fire ignition mechanism and extinguishing method is not obtained. Because it is difficult to carry out the cable combustion test in full-size high-voltage switchgear. In this paper, a full-size test platform was built, and the temperature distribution of a switchgear during the electrical induced fire ignition was recorded. Secondly, the simulation model of the switchgear was constructed and the law of fire spread was mastered. Then, the process of cable material decomposition and the effect of material decomposition on cable combustion were analyzed. Finally, the start threshold of a fire extinguishing device was determined based on the temperature field distribution in the test. The results provide a reference for the design of fire extinguishing devices in high voltage switchgear.

articleTitle: Electric Field Distribution under Lightning and Sensor Arrangement Scheme in Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to collect operating parameters of transformer more accurately, it is often necessary to arrange the sensor inside the transformer. There is a strong electromagnetic field distribution inside the transformer, so the electromagnetic compatibility problem of the sensor arranged inside the transformer is particularly prominent. In this paper, a distribution transformer high voltage coil is built, and potential distribution of transformer coils under the impact of a standard lightning wave with an amplitude of 75kV is solved. Based on the potential distribution, the finite element method(FEM) is used to calculate the electric field in transformer. We can get from simulation result that electric field(E-field) in transformer reaches the maximum value at 53 μs; E-field at top of iron core is much lower than that on left and right sides. In general, the E-field on top side of iron core is much lower than that on left and right sides, and the sensor is best arranged in the central area at top of core, where the E-field approximately equals to 0; if sensors must be arranged on A-phase and C-phase iron core, then sensors should be arranged as close as possible to ends of iron core, where E-field strength is about 0.3 kV/cm.

articleTitle: High-Step-Down ZVS Synchronous Rectified DC-DC Converter With High Accurate Output Regulation In Wide Operation Range
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A high-step-down digital controlled isolated DC-DC converter with a wide input/output operation range is popular in industrial applications. This paper presents a high-step-down isolated DC-DC converter with accurate output regulation ability (≤0.5%) in a wide operation range. The active clamp circuit and full-bridge ZVS synchronous rectification are implemented for efficiency concerns. The planar magnetic technique is employed to reduce volume and maintain parameter consistency. Meanwhile, combining the high resolutions of DSP I/O configurations, a simple effective control approach for the accurate output voltage regulation is found. A 180-420V wide input voltage range and 28V/10A output isolated DC-DC converter prototype is built and tested to verify the effectiveness of the converter.

articleTitle: An Efficient Denoising Algorithm for Power Quality Disturbance in Fractional Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The denoising of power quality disturbance is an important subject for power quality monitoring and analysis. With the integration of nonlinear and rapid loads, power quality disturbance may present non-stationary behavior in power electronic systems. By analyzing the energy distribution of power quality disturbance, an improved denoising algorithm based on the fractional Fourier transform is proposed. Meanwhile, estimation algorithm of the optimal transform angle is also analyzed. The fourth order origin moment of fractional spectrum is employed to reduce the computational complexity. Compared to the wavelet-based method, the proposed algorithm can achieve better performance for both transient disturbance and chirp disturbance. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Induced Voltage and Current of 500kV Multi-circuit Transmission Lines on the Same Tower Based on Ridge Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The mixed-voltage multi-circuit transmission line on the same tower effectively solves the problems faced by line transformation and construction under the condition of increasingly scarce transmission corridors, but it will produce strong electromagnetic coupling and electrostatic coupling, causing large induced voltage and current, has brought new challenges to the construction and transformation of the line. In order to ensure that the parameters of the GIS equipment in the station are selected reasonably and the operation is stable and reliable, it is essential to carry out simulation calculation research and make predictions for its different operating conditions. This paper uses ATP-EMTP simulation software to simulate a 500kV multi-circuit transmission line on the same tower, and uses a ridge regression model based on sklearn machine learning algorithm to predict the induced voltage and current, and provides equipment selection for Zhongxing Penglai power plant to Yantai 500kV switchyard reference basis

articleTitle: Design Scheme of Shared Tower Grounding Network Based on Uniform Ground Potential
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The grounding standard of mobile base station in shared tower is relatively strict, so it is necessary to transform the grounding network of traditional transmission tower to meet the grounding requirement of base station. In this paper, the method of field-circuit coupling is adopted to treat the ground conductor in sections, calculate the self-resistance and cross-resistance of each section conductor, derive the solution formula of ground potential of grounding grid of shared tower, and then judge the uniformity of ground potential of grounding grid. Referring to the existing grounding standard of power and communication, the design idea and 4 design schemes of shared tower grounding grid are put forward. The results show that the ground potential distribution is the most uniform and the maximum potential gradient is 43.83% lower than that of the simple plan of expanding the area of the ground network.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Adjustment Coefficient of Generator Units in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Under the background of “emission peak and carbon neutral”, the dynamic reactive power support of the power grid will have a large deficit, and the adjustment coefficient can improve the dynamic reactive power support of power grid. In this paper, with the goal of maximizing the increase in bus voltage within a certain period of time after a fault, a method for optimizing the adjustment coefficient based on the ranking of transient voltage sensitivity indexes is proposed; and it is verified that this method can improve the dynamic reactive power support ability of the grid-related generators. Finally, the simulation results show that this method has a good effect on suppressing the DC commutation failure of Shanghai Power Grid and benefit to the stability of the generators and the power grid.

articleTitle: Regulation of Surface Trap Distribution on Silicone Rubber by Radio Frequency Fluorocarbon Plasma
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The surface trap distribution of insulating materials has a significant effect on the electrical resistance along the surface. Therefore, RF capacitive coupled plasma (CCP) was applied to modify the surface of silicone rubber in low-pressure CF4 gas. A one-dimensional fluid model of CCP based COMSOL simulation software was established. The electron temperature, electron number density, and ion density distribution of plasma were analyzed, and the surface treatment parameters of plasma were determined. The surface morphology and chemical structure of samples were observed by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The charge attenuation and the trap distribution were measured by an isothermal surface potential attenuation system. The results show that CCP treatment can introduce fluorinated groups into the surface of silicone rubber and increase the surface roughness. After CCP treatment, the surface charge attenuation of silicone rubber is inhibited and the electron trap is deepened, which is beneficial to suppress the development of secondary electron collapse on the surface and improve its electrical resistance along the surface.

articleTitle: A Power Adaptive Energy Harvesting System Based on Magnetic Field Reverse Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper establishes a power adaptive energy harvesting system based on magnetic field reverse cancellation to provide power for the monitoring equipment on the transmission line. A current transformer with two secondary coils is adopted in this method. One coil induces current from the magnetic field generated by the current on the transmission line to supply power to the load, and the other coil draws current from the load. After inversion, a magnetic field opposite to the original magnetic field is created in the magnetic core to cancel the original magnetic field to a certain extent to achieve the self-adaptive energy harvest. Therefore, when the current of the high-voltage transmission line varies in a large range, the system can adjust the acquired power to ensure the normal operation of the load. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by means of numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-voltage source inertia matching control strategy based on droop control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the high proportion of renewable energy connected to the grid, the reliability and quality of power supply have also become an important research topic. Aiming at the power outage problem in disaster situations, the inertia matching control strategy of the mobile diesel generator and the voltage source inverter is studied. The multi-voltage source inertia matching control strategy based on droop control is proposed in this paper. The optimization effect of the inertia matching strategy in transient and steady state is verified by simulation software, which improves the reliability of power supply

articleTitle: Arm Capacitor Voltage Divergence Suppressing and Stability Improving for an MMC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Natural arm capacitor voltage balancing of the direct modulated modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been presented in some publications. However, the effect of submodule (SM) voltage control is not considered. This paper reveals that capacitor voltage balancing control may lead to SM voltage divergence between the upper and lower arms. A model of the direct modulated MMC is established, and subsystem of circulating current and arm capacitor voltage is linearized and analyzed. Based on the analysis, a control parameter design principle to effectively suppress arm capacitor voltage diverging and improve the system stability is proposed. The effectiveness of the theoretical analysis and proposed control parameter design principle is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Interval Robust State Estimation Based on Uncertainty Measurement Error
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The state estimation based on measurement error often deviates from the actual state of power system, mainly because the error interval assumed cannot contain the true value. To solve this problem, an interval robust state estimation method based on uncertain measurement error (IRSE) have been proposed. The method have used interval state estimation (ISE) to obtain the error interval which containing the true value, and based on the measurement uncertainty state estimation model (MNMR) to implement robust state estimation. Compared with MNMR and weighted least squares state estimation (WLS), the method avoid the misjudgment of MNMR on bad data, and has an obvious improvement on estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of High Voltage Distribution Network with Access to Distributed Energy Based on Power Flow Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: It is a problem that the connection of distributed energy to the power grid, which also affects the power quality. After the distributed energy is connected to the power grid, the power flow calculation of the distributed energy cannot be calculated such as that of the traditional power grid, and therefore, it is necessary to consider the situation with distributed energy access based on traditional power flow calculation. Considering the static characteristics of constant power, constant current and constant impedance load voltage, this paper establishes the power flow calculation models of different types of distributed generators after grid connection. By establishing the high-voltage distribution network model in Huanghua, Qinghai Province, the power quality of the power grid when the power station is connected and not connected under light and heavy load is analyzed, which further shows that the model is suitable for the power flow calculation of different types of distributed energy.

articleTitle: Research on Modulation Strategy of Integrated Control of Motoring and Braking for BLDCM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The article proposes a modulation strategy (MODUS) that can realize the integrated control of brushless DC motor(BLDCM) motoring and braking.
