Using this strategy, the motor can freely switch between motoring and braking states without additional control commands, which is of great significance for the application of BLDCM in automatic driving or constant-speed cruise. For the convenience of explanation, firstly, the MODUS of the BLDCM motoring state and braking in the existing control method is introduced. Then, an integrated MODUS is proposed and its working principle is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An Inrush Current Suppression Strategy for Fast Voltage Recovery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: When a short-circuit fault occurs, the inverter will switch from the voltage control mode (VCM) to the current control mode (CCM), limiting the output current to the set value to cooperate with the action of relay protection device of fault branch. After the fault is removed, the inverter switches to the voltage control mode to quickly recover the output voltage and reduce the power-off time. However, sudden applied voltage may produce inrush current with large amplitude which will cause output voltage distortion and even cause damage to the transformer. Therefore, an inrush current suppression method is proposed in this paper. This method extracts the asymmetric component formed by inrush current by calculating the average value of transformer primary side current of each fundamental period. Using it as the negative feedback input of inrush current controller to suppress inrush current. Simulation and experiment results verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Magnetically mediated thermoacoustic detecting for conductivity of energy storage materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to detect the conductivity of energy storage materials in energy storage devices by non-destructive imaging, we used Magnetically Mediated Thermoacoustic Detecting Method (MMTDM). MMTDM is a new resistance anti-imaging technology that generates an inductive magnetic field by injecting pulsed current into the excitation coil, and the metal material expands instantaneously after absorbing joule heat into the induced magnetic field, emitting an ultrasonic signal with conductivity information, collecting the ultrasonic signal, and rebuilding the conductivity distribution. In this study, an experimental platform for MMTDM was built, and a single-pulse and two-pulse comparison experiment was carried out to observe the strength of ultrasonic signals emitted by energy storage materials. This study proves that the dual pulse high frequency narrow pulse excitation source can make the energy storage materials produce stronger ultrasonic signal, and provides a good theoretical and experimental basis for the study of MMTDM.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Market Demand Analysis Based on Market Segmentation Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed photovoltaic power generation technology in China, an increasing number of entities such as investors, equipment suppliers, and integrated energy companies will participate in distributed photovoltaic market transactions. In response to the current low degree of marketization of distributed photovoltaics in China and the lagging of public services, this paper establishes a market segmentation model based on market segmentation theory. It analyzes the main body and business structure of various sub-markets, and taps the demand characteristics of relevant main sub-markets. So it builds the foundation for the improvement of market service capabilities.

articleTitle: Application of KKS Coding and QR Code Technology in Transmission Asset Management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Based on the research and application of transmission equipment asset life intelligent control technology, this paper introduces the current problems of traditional transmission asset management, the construction of transmission asset life cycle information coding system and the expected application results. In order to accelerate the digitization of the new power system and the intelligence of the asset management work of the whole life cycle to improve the flexibility and efficiency of asset management, this paper builds transmission asset life cycle encoding system using Interactive Location Code, Item Information Code, Equipment Information Code and Check Code, uses the application of digital scanning device and QR code technology to break the data barrier of multiple service systems and realize the tracking and recording of transmission asset life cycle information.

articleTitle: Effect of Na+ on Molecular Relaxation of Epoxy/Alumina Resin Composites
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Epoxy resin is an insulating material widely used in high-voltage electrical equipment, and Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> is one of the main impurity ions in epoxy resin. In this research, we added different mass fraction Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> into epoxy/alumina composites. After that, we measured the gel time, glass transition temperature and broadband dielectric spectrum. Besides, we used H-N function to fit the data of dielectric spectrum,used VFT function to calculate the activation energy of macromolecular chains. The gel time data showed that Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> can promote the gelation of epoxy composite castables. The glass transition temperature proved that Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> can promote crosslinking. The calculation results of dielectric fitting showed that Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> can increase the activation energy of macromolecular chains and increases the intensity of ion ionization. This research reveal the effect of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> on molecular relaxation in epoxy composites and provide reference for the control of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> content in epoxy composites.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Full Bridge Bidirectional DC-AC Converter Based on V2G Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a new bidirectional DC-AC converter is proposed. The circuit topology of this converter mainly consists of a battery, DC-side filter, energy storage inductor, bus capacitor, asymmetric inverter bridge, AC-side filter and grid, and four circuit modes exist during normal operation. For the application of V2G, a dual-target control strategy is proposed for the converter that can realize bidirectional power transfer and power decoupling, and its circuit topology, control strategy, operating principle and key circuit parameters design are analyzed and studied in depth. The simulation results show that the proposed converter can realize single-stage bi-directional power transfer, with the advantages of simple circuit topology, high quality of grid-connected current waveform and low frequency pulsation of DC-side battery current, which provides a practical new solution for V2G technology.

articleTitle: The Design of a Visualized Intelligent Detection Device for Cable Wells
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the extension of the power networks, the cables are widely laid, increasing the burden on inspection power cable operators. To ensure the safety of workers in the cable wells and improve their work efficiency, a visualized intelligent detection device for cable wells is designed in this paper. The device integrates multiple functions, such as temperature and humidity detection, hazardous gas detection, and portable electronic imaging. It can realize real-time monitoring of the equipment in the cable well by electric power operators on the ground. In addition, the temperature, humidity, and hazardous gas content in the well can be measured simultaneously. The device overcomes the problem of the single function of the traditional detection device. And it solves the problem of difficulty and danger of going down the well in the traditional operation method. The experimental results show that the intelligent detection device has the advantages of reliable operation, high sensitivity, and convenient portability. It has important application value for improving the efficiency of power maintenance operations.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Analysis of Novel Advanced Adiabatic Compressed Air Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In recent years, advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage (AA-CAES) system has been greatly developed in the energy storage areas, but its performance is limited by the gradual decrease of air temperature in the gas storage tank during the process of energy release. In order to further improve the performance of AA-CAECS system, this paper proposes a method of adjusting air temperature in gas storage by turbine waste heat. On this basis, this paper establishes a novel AA-CAES system(N-AA-CAES) that uses turbine waste heat to adjust the temperature of gas storage tank and establishes thermodynamic model of the N-AA-CAES. Combined with the thermodynamic analysis, the method of adjusting air temperature in gas storage by turbine waste heat can effectively improve the performance of N-AA-CAES system. Case study shows that, compared with AA-CAES, the electric-electric conversion efficiency of N-AA-CAES system is increased by 10.55%, the energy storage density of N-AACAES system is increased by 10.58%.

Author Keywords: Waste heat heats the gas tank

articleTitle: Simulation of Vacuum Arc Characteristics with Magnetohydrodynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As an important way to explore the ablation of vacuum switch electrodes, simulation of vacuum arc characteristics has become a hit in its field. A two-dimensional magneto-hydrodynamic model was established to simulate vacuum arc in this paper. The electrode radius and the gap distance were set to 25mm and 10mm respectively, according to the typical parameters of a vacuum interrupter and boundary conditions were set according to experimental data. The simulation results shown that: 1) A 10kA vacuum arc plasma flow is in subsonic state, and the maximum pressure appears in the center of cathode. 2) As plasma flows from cathode to anode, ion temperature and electron temperature increase, and their maximum temperature reach 7.2 eV and 7.4 eV, respectively. 3) the maximum energy flux density reaches $220 MW/m^{2}$ on anode surface, and electron energy flow density occupies the main part.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method of Power Transformer Based on Improved DDAG-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology, neural networks, fuzzy technology, expert systems, grey system theory, fuzzy clustering and other methods have gradually been applied to transformer fault diagnosis, and have achieved better diagnostic results. However, the above methods all have certain shortcomings. For example, knowledge-based methods such as artificial neural networks need to obtain an infinite number of fault samples, and the training time is long, and there are problems such as local optimal solutions; This paper proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method based on the improved DDAG-SVM, which enriches the transformer fault diagnosis information, and combines the dissolved gas composition, content and change in the oil, operating voltage and current and other information to establish a comprehensive fault diagnosis system based on the transformer. It is helpful to guide the efficient development of maintenance.

articleTitle: An Identification Algorithm of Low Voltage User-Transformer Relationship Based on Improved Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The accuracy of user-transformer relationship identification plays a key role in the safe and stable operation of the distribution network, and its results directly affect the accuracy of line loss calculation of the distribution network. The traditional distribution station recognition algorithm cluster the power frequency zero-crossing sequence, which does not perform well when the sequence is ‘non-convex’. Accordingly, an improved spectral clustering algorithm for arbitrary zero-crossing sequences is proposed. The algorithm takes maximizing the variance of the weight matrix (WM) as the objective function of the adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm, then adaptively selects the parameter threshold of WM to change the WM into a sparse matrix. Thus, the eigenvectors calculation problem of the traditional spectral clustering algorithm is simplified to find the orthogonal null space of the canonical Laplace matrix. The recognition accuracy of the proposed algorithm with sample data obtained by the simulation software can reach 99.11%, which is better than that of the traditional clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Validation of a Behind-the-meter BESS Control with degradation Cost by Hardware Experiments
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To addresses the voltage issue in the distribution network caused by high PV penetration and the high cost of energy storage systems, a behind-the-meter battery scheduling and control algorithm has been proposed in this paper. The proposed solution includes a control framework that can schedule the day-ahead battery operation and prevent overvoltage in distribution systems. Two different techniques that aim to prolong battery life have been quantified, one is a hardware-based technique that uses a parallel connected supercapacitor to absorb large charging and discharging current; the other is a software-based technique that considers the battery degradation cost as part of the scheduling optimization. The proposed algorithm is evaluated via both the numerical simulation in the IEEE 13-node test feeder and hardware experiments. Based on the experiment results, a long-term system economic analysis has been made.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Damping Torque Analysis of Power System Stabilizer for Suppressing Ultra-low Frequency Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Ultra-low frequency oscillation (ULFO) will cause overcurrent tripping of tie line and out of step splitting between system and unit or system, which will affect the safe and stable operation of power grid. Therefore, it is necessary to study the suppression measures of ULFO. Power system stabilizer can be used to suppress ULFO. Firstly, the mechanism of generator excitation system affecting ULFO is analyzed. When the load has voltage regulation effect, the generator excitation system affects the ULFO by affecting the load voltage and then the load power. Furthermore, the process of frequency deviation affecting electromagnetic power through power system stabilizer, excitation system, network and load is given. The damping coefficient of electromagnetic power is calculated by damping torque method, and the influence of power system stabilizer on ULFO is analyzed. Finally, the simulation is carried out in IEEE 4-machine 2-zone system.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of an Electromagnetic Vibration Energy Harvester Based on Magnetic Suction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel electromagnetic vibration energy harvester (EVEH), that utilizes the magnetic suction of the opposite pole to provide the restoring force required for vibration, is presented. It consists of the induction coils, cylindrical and cuboid permanent magnets, of which the two magnets make up a special array that can enhance the magnetic field strength within the induction coils. The purpose of this article is to verify the effectiveness of this novel structure. The influence of structure parameters of the novel EVEH on output performance are analyzed by 3-D numerical model. And make a prototype of EVEH and conduct experimental tests. In the laboratory, experimental tests have shown that the maximum output power density is up to 1.288 mW/cm3 at 13.1 Hz. This vibration energy harvester can output effective power. Compared with other structures, the system has a higher resonance frequency but higher output power density.

articleTitle: Robustness Optimization of Model Predictive Voltage Control for PMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Owing to the strong dependence of model predictive control on system parameters, the whole system will be unstable when the parameters are disturbed. Therefore, this paper aims to strengthen the parameters robustness of the prediction control system. Specifically, a sliding-mode based model predictive voltage control is proposed to regulate the parameter disturbance. And a reference voltage predictive function is constructed on the foundation of the designed sliding mode reaching law. Finally, aiming at verifying the parameter robustness of the proposed strategy, the motor parameters are changed by building simulation, and the conventional method is compared with it. And the availability of the proposed strategy is proved.

articleTitle: Methodologies of Feature Extraction for Voltage Sags in Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper presents methodologies of feature extraction for voltage sags in power systems, from several points of view, throughout the recent years. Study some algorithms about extractions and classifiers, and focus on the accuracy and efficiency of the algorithms in this paper. It also summarizes the algorithms whereas it shows the remaining challenges that requires on feature extraction in the further research.

articleTitle: A Coil Winding Method for Current Balance in Multi-Paralleled-Litz-Wire-Based Ultra-Thin IPT Pads
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Inductive power transfer (IPT) technology can simplify the consumer electronic charging process, whereas the height and the volume of a consumer electronic are limited, and the thickness of the receiving pad is required to be thin. In this work, multi-paralleled Litz wires (MPLWs) are used to decrease the pad thickness. However, unbalance current problem in the MPLWs, leading to unbalance wire-losses and extra power loss on the receiving pad, cannot be ignored due to the differences among inductances, mutual inductances, and cross mutual inductances of the wires. Thus, a circuit model is established to analyze the unbalance currents. Then, a coil winding method is proposed to alleviate the unbalance currents. Finally, a 720 W prototype with an ultra-thin 2.5 mm receiving pad is built to validate the performance of the proposed approach. The results show that with the proposed method, both the phase differences and the amplitude differences among the currents flowing through the paralleled wires can be reduced, the standard deviation of the currents decreases from 1.46 A to 0.03 A, the currents become uniform, and the system efficiency is improved 1.1% from 93.1% to 94.2%.

articleTitle: Energy-Saving Operation Strategy for Subway Trains Considering Regenerative Brake Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamics model and energy consumption model for subway trains are established. Based on the models, a speed trajectory optimization strategy for subway trains considering the utilization of regenerative brake energy is designed. In order to ensure the executable of the optimization strategy, a terminal sliding mode fault-tolerant control strategy is designed for speed and position tracking of a subway train. Finally, a simulation case is designed based on the train data from Beijing Batong Line to prove the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Parameter Optimization of Grid-connected Converter During Low Voltage Ride Through
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: When the grid voltage drops due to grid fault, the voltage source converter (VSC) under the weak grid will enter the stage of low voltage ride through (LVRT). Many countries have formulated corresponding standards, i.e. reactive power compensation is performed according to the grid voltage to support the grid. However, there are stability issues when using the LVRT strategy. This paper first reveals the conditions for the existence of equilibrium points and their distribution under the typical LVRT strategy. Besides, the setting of the current order is investigated for avoiding instability. Furthermore, the influence of bandwidths on stability range is analyzed and the selection of bandwidth to maintain stability is studied. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Study on electrical characteristics of planar DBD Structure excited by high frequency AC power supply
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the structural defects of coaxial DBD and surface DBD, a planar DBD structure suitable for large-area plasma generation is designed in this paper, and the effects of voltage amplitude, gas velocity and oxygen content on the electrical characteristics of planar DBD structure driven by high-frequency AC power supply are studied. The increase of voltage amplitude will increase the discharge current of planar DBD structure The discharge power increases. The increase of gas flow rate will also increase the discharge current and discharge power of DBD structure, but the effect of gas flow rate tends to saturation when it reaches a certain value. The electronegativity of oxygen will weaken the electron collision process, inhibit the discharge, weaken the intensity of discharge, reduce the discharge power and reduce the discharge current.

articleTitle: EPICS Based Distributed Beam Optimization Framework in HUSTFEL Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The compact terahertz free electron laser light source requires high quality of electron beam. For the long time the beam tuning tasks were done by operators manually, however it is challenging for operators to obtain ideal beam quality. Automatic beam tuning methods using optimization algorithms are required. Therefore a software framework, the sequential decision-making framework, has been developed so as to utilize existing tuning methods and newly emerged intelligent control techniques in the accelerator control community. The framework can serve as a platform for the development, test and demonstration of different control algorithms. It can also support normal tasks like automatic emittance measurement and remnant magnetism removal of quadrupoles. Since the completion of the framework, the efficiency of the laboratory operations has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Active Voltage Arc Suppression Method Based on Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the existing arc suppression methods that it is difficult to suppress intermittent grounding arcs, there is a risk of resonance when the device exits, and the capacity of the equipment is limited. This paper proposes an active voltage arc suppression method based on cascaded H-bridge converters. The fault phase voltage will be reduced to zero by using the active voltage arc suppression method to control the multi-level converter to output a suitable voltage value. The output voltage value of the device is gradually reduced to zero when it exits, which provides a release loop for the capacitor charge. The principle and advantages of active voltage arc suppression will be discussed in this paper. At the same time, the principle on the suppression of fault current transient components will be analyzed. Finally, the theoretical analysis is simulated and verified by PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the proposed arc suppression method can effectively suppress arc overvoltage without the risk of resonance.

articleTitle: ICPT System Analysis and Maximum Power Tracking Based on Adaptive Step P&O
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The resonant model of the inductively coupled power transmission (ICPT) system is analyzed. In the case of the series compensation model on the secondary side, the configuration conditions of the constant output current model compensation network on the primary side are derived, which can be applied to all compensation modes. System efficiency is optimized by blocks. Moreover, the output power level is evaluated based on the maximum power output of the power supply and the reflection coefficient of the power input port. Finally, the adaptive step P& O algorithm (ASP& O) is introduced to realize that when the load changes, the system can be restored to the maximum power output state by adjusting the duty cycle of the DC/DC converter under resonance without establishing signal feedback from the primary side.

articleTitle: Market Potential Evaluation of Integrated Energy Services in New Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As the goal of emission peak and carbon neutrality is proposed, modern power system will develop into a new power system. Integrated energy service, as one of the products of new power system, has great market potentials. Therefore, how to quantitatively assess the real investment potentials and market benefits of various integrated energy service projects in different districts has become a pivotal issue. In this paper, a kind of market potential analysis method of integrated energy service in new power system is put forward. First, the largest market potential was evaluated. Then, based on the diffusion theory, the potential analysis model and parameter modification were proposed to calculate the actual market scale. Moreover, economic, social and environmental benefits of those integrated energy service projects were analyzed. Last but not least, Jiangyin District was taken as an example for case study, together with related suggestions for integrated energy services.

articleTitle: Dissolved Gases in Natural Ester and Modified Ester Under Thermal Faults for Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With increasing attention to environmentally friendly characteristics of power transformer insulating liquid, natural ester, synthetic ester and modified ester have gradually become alternative insulating liquids for transformers. Owing to the lack of data on dissolved gases in natural and modified esters for transformer, this study presents experimental results on dissolved gases in natural and modified esters under typical thermal faults. The experimental results show that the content and proportion of dissolved gases in different types of insulating liquids under the same thermal fault simulation are different due to the differences in their chemical compositions. Furthermore, to better explain the law of gas generation and the process of degradation, gassing behavior, neutralization titration, ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy, and infrared spectroscopy have been used to analyze the influence of thermal faults on insulating liquids. It can be concluded that the natural and modified ester produce acids, aldehydes, and other compounds under thermal faults, and the decomposition pathways of these products are different for natural and modified esters, For the diagnosis of power transformer thermal faults, different criteria are needed.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Oscillation Analysis and Suppression Based on Improved PLL Structure for Vehicle-Grid System of High-speed Railways
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Recently, the low-frequency oscillation (LFO) has occurred frequently in vehicle-grid system of high-speed railways. In this paper, the phase-locked loop (PLL) structure is enhanced to restrain the LFO of the vehicle-grid system, and the impedance mathematical model of the vehicle-grid system based on the improved PLL is bulit. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the improved PLL in suppressing the LFO is verified based on the generalized Nyquist stability criterion and the Starsim-based hardware-in-loop (HIL) platform. In addition, an improved impedance measurement method for single-phase system is proposed to verify the accuracy of the impedance mathematical model of rectifier based on the improvement of PLL. Compared with the previous dq impedance measurement method, the proposed method can effectively reduce the times of disturbance injection, simplifying the measurement procedure.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy of Integrated Energy System Considering Compressed Air Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Compressed air energy storage can store electricity and heat at the same time. In addition, CAES has lower energy storage costs and long life. This paper studies the operating characteristics and mathematical models of compressed air energy storage, and establishes a mathematical model of an integrated energy system containing electricity, heat and gas. On this basis, with the goal of optimizing the total cost, a scheduling model including compressed air energy storage to participate in the operation of the electric-heat-gas integrated energy system is constructed, and operation constraints such as power balance and ramp constraints are considered. Finally, a numerical example is analyzed to verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Partial Discharge Defects in GIS Support Insulator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The support insulator is one of the components with high probability of failure in GIS equipment, and the along-surface flashover and air gap defects are serious threats to the safe operation of GIS equipment. The paper proposes a method of GIS internal defect diagnosis and location based on UHF signal. Combined with the online monitoring system, the paper introduces its application process in the detection and locating of the air gap discharge of the GIS support insulator in operation. The partial discharge type is distinguished by the phase resolved partial discharge pattern recognition, and the locating of partial discharge is based on the time difference method. The disassembly analysis of GIS equipment verifies the effectiveness of the above method used by the GIS online monitoring system and avoids further development of partial discharge leading to unplanned busbar outages or serious accident. The application characteristics of partial discharge technology are analyzed in conjunction with the case study to provide reference for insulation monitoring of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: A Power Oscillation Damping Method for LCC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a power oscillation damping method to improve the damping characteristic of LCC-HVDC system. Firstly, the LCC-HVDC linearized model is established based on the motion equation concept. Then, the damping characteristic of LCC-HVDC system is analyzed. The analysis results show the impacts of DC current controller parameter and proposed power oscillation damping controller on the damping coefficients, which relate to the stability margin of LCC-HVDC system. Finally, the simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC verify the accuracy of damping characteristic analysis of the LCC-HVDC system and the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Design of Double Redundancy Controller for Electric Actuator Based on Dual three-phase PMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The harsh operating conditions of equipment in the aerospace field put strict requirements on the reliability and servo performance of the motor drive system. For this reason, a set of servo drive system with double redundancy of motor and controller is proposed in this paper. First, overall structure of the proposed double redundancy servo drive system is introduced. Second, the starting and braking process of the servo system and the method to improve the dynamic performance of the servo system is studied, including the design of current closed loop, speed closed loop and position closed loop. Finally, to eliminate the imbalance of winding current, torque ripple and inconsistent timing in the traditional dual-redundancy electric actuator control system, a dual-redundancy synchronization control scheme is proposed. The reliability of the control system is improved while reducing the cost of the system. The effectiveness of the proposed methods is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Iron loss analysis of permanent magnet segmentation in FSCW permanent magnet synchronous machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Investigation of iron loss in fractional slot concentrated winding (FSCW) machine due to permanent magnet segmentation (PMS) are presented in this paper. First, the numerical calculation method and four models for predicting the iron loss are given, which are named as reduced segmented (RST), equal segmented distributed (EQSDT), equal segmented centralized (EQSCT) and non-segmented Formulas (NST), they are based on the influence factors of PM content, segmentation and location. Then, the detailed comparison of the analysis, including back emf, harmonic content, iron loss and eddy-current loss on machine are described and delivers that it can reduce the loss of machine, but different structure has different effects on the iron loss due to the different ways of placement, compared with others, the EQSDT can effectively reduce iron loss by reducing harmonic content and stator yoke magnetic flux density. Numerical calculations and finite element analysis have reached consistent conclusions, and this type of analysis is also suitable for other machines.

articleTitle: The Impact of Voltage Sag Depth and Duration on SVG Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As an active three-phase unbalanced load compensation device, the static var generator (SVG) can control the magnitude, amplitude and phase of the AC-side voltage, thus achieving flexible control of reactive power and compensation of voltage sag, but its application results will be affected by the grid parameters. Recent studies often do not quantitatively analyze the impact of fault depth and fault duration on the device management result in the case of voltage sag. In this paper, the working principle of SVG equipment is analyzed, and the modeling analysis and control design of three-phase SVG devices are carried out; the mechanism of voltage sag acting in the main and control circuits is analyzed, the main causes leading to equipment instability are quantitatively analyzed, and the different effects of different depths and duration of voltage sags on SVG equipment are analyzed. Finally, the conclusion is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Self-Distillation for Low-Dose CT Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As a medical imaging technique, computed tomography (CT) has been widely used in clinical internal visualization, lesion detection and disease tracking. But excessive radiation will cause adverse effects on patients. Lowering the radiation dose can alleviate this problem, but it will lead to the degradation of CT images. In this paper, we propose a knowledge distillation-based denoising method for low-dose CT images. The teacher network trained with higher dose data can generate soft labels for the student network to avoid information loss. The experiments prove that the model trained with our proposed method outperforms the original model in terms of detail preservation.

articleTitle: Study on PT secondary interference of 1000kV GIS substation based on SWT transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to explore the interference characteristics of Very Fast Transient Overvoltage (VFTO) on secondary equipment, this paper uses a self-made secondary side interference measurement device to measure the voltage of a 1000kV Gas Insulated Substation (GIS). The common mode interference on the secondary side of the Potential Transformer (PT) was measured on site. In this paper, the synchronous compression wavelet transform is used for time-frequency analysis of the measured waveform. The actual measurement results in this paper show that the peak-to-peak common-mode interference voltage on the secondary side of the PT can reach 9. 65kV, and the maximum frequency of micro-pulses is about 1kHz. The Fourier analysis of micro-pulse shows that the greater the amplitude of the interference pulse on the secondary side of the PT, the more abundant the frequency. The time-frequency analysis results of the micro-pulse show that the 7. 8MHz frequency component has a high amplitude and the dominant frequency component of the PT secondary side interference is always throughout the waveform. The amplitude of other frequency components begins to decay rapidly after the waveform occurs, and the duration is different.

articleTitle: Frequency Characteristics Analysis on Frequency-dependent Parameters Based Bipolar HVDC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Currently, the bipolar operation mode is used to increase the transmission capacity of the HVDC system. However, the bipolar lines presence of coupling phenomena. Therefore, transient analysis on bipolar lines should establish in mode domain. In this paper, the frequency-dependent parameters based bipolar lines with coupling characteristics are decoupled first. Then, the frequency characteristics of the modulus impedance and propagation are simulation analyzed in mode domain. The simulation results show that, the modulus impedance decreased with frequency increasing and finally stabilized; the 0-mode and 1-mode propagation function both have the property of low-pass filter, but the amplitude of 0-mode propagation function attenuate more intense compared with 1-mode. The calculation results on the cut-off frequency of the 0-mode propagation function and 1-mode propagation function show that, the algorithm of high frequency protection and transient protection should adopt the high-frequency signal of 1-mode component, and 0-mode component can be used to select the faulty line.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Calculation Method for Dynamic Core Temperature of 110kV Cables Laying in Pipes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The laying environment for 110kV cables laying in pipes is complicated and is more affected by environmental factors. In order to calculate the dynamic core temperature of 110kV cables laying in pipes more accurately, 5 kinds of environmental factors for 110kV cables laying in pipes are analyzed through finite element simulation. And the dynamic environmental thermal resistance is added to the transient thermal circuit model. An optimization method for calculating the dynamic core temperature of 110kV cables laying in pipes is obtained and the calculation accuracy of this method is compared with the existing method.

articleTitle: Design of on-line monitoring system for end shield of transformer high voltage bushing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Bushing maintenance is a normal operation in power substations, but the maintenance cycle is too long in fixed period power outage maintenance schemas which decreasing the maintenance accuracy. In this paper, an on-line brushing monitoring system is proposed to change the situation. A kind of on-line monitoring device for the end shield of the bushing is developed to ensure casing equipment insulation defects in time. According to the structure of the system, the design of the local signal conditioning circuit, the high-speed acquisition circuit and the power function circuit are demonstrated. Finally, the test results show that the on-line monitoring system is effective for monitoring the test results show that the on-line monitoring system is effective for monitoring the running state of high voltage busing in real time.

articleTitle: Influence of Pole Number Combination on Magnetic Field of Wound Rotor Brushless Doubly-fed Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Wound rotor Brushless Doubly-fed Machine(BDFM) is a new type of motor. The internal magnetic field of BDFM is complicated. The magnetic field characteristics of BDFM are deduced by analytical method.In order to eliminate the unbalanced magnetic pull on both sides of the rotor, the influences of the pole number combination of stator on the motor magnetic field and the electromagnetic force are studied. Taking two wound rotor BDFMs with different pole number combinations as examples, the field-circuit coupling models of the motor are established, the magnetic field characteristics of the BDFM are verified, and the effects of pole number combination on the air-gap magnetic field, rotor surface electromagnetic force and electromagnetic torque are analyzed. Finally, the effects of pole number combination on the local electromagnetic force of the BDFM rotor are studied. This paper provides data support for the design and performance improvement of wound rotor BDFM.

articleTitle: Using Memory Alloy Material to Solve the Problem of Ice-covered Sag of Overhead Ground Wire of Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the hazards of the ice-covered sag of the overhead ground wire of the transmission line, understands and grasps the causes of the excessive grounding sag of the high-voltage power line. To reduce the overhead ground wire ice sag, based on the conductor LGJ- 240/30 type, ground of GJ- 50 type ground of high voltage transmission lines ice sag problem as the research object, using shape memory alloy material temperature deformation characteristics has designed two kinds of overhead ground wire ice sag, using memory alloy temperature of phase transformation point of turning force on ground wire, make it keep safe distance between wires, and auxiliary deicing, automatically. The stress, sag, tension and gravity of the ground wire are calculated with the typical overhead ground wire design, and the memory alloy spring is selected. According to the design scheme, the simulation test is carried out and the feasibility of the design scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Initial Position Detection of Synchronous Motor Based on Improved HF Signal Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Initial rotor position detection is vital to ensure the starting process of static frequency converter (SFC), which is used for the control of synchronous motor in pumped storage power station. This paper has proposed a novel method based on rotating high frequency signal injecting into estimated synchronous reference frame (SynRF). With the improved demodulation method, it is easy to extract rotor position and is immune from delays caused by digital control, resistance, filters and other nonlinear factors. Furthermore, the magnetic polarity is proposed based on magnetic saturation effect, without extra signal injection and is of high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Finally, the experimental results have proved the validity and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Method for Obtaining Leakage Inductance Based on Current Coupling in Unsaturated Zone
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The accurate leakage inductance value of the transformer primary and secondary side leakage inductance is the key to the theoretical and simulation analysis of the transformer inrush current transient characteristics. First, the transformer differential equation is deduced, and two calculation expressions for solving leakage inductance under system balance and unbalance are obtained. Aiming at the scenario where the circular current of the delta winding cannot be measured, a parameter acquisition method based on current coupling characteristics in unsaturated zone is proposed. This method takes advantage of the mutual coupling between the circular current of the delta winding and the non-saturated phase current of the primary side. First judge the unsaturated phase, and then use the opposite of the unsaturated phase current instead of the circulating current to solve the quasi-leakage inductance under the two expressions. The quasi-leakage inductance values in the unsaturated zone are almost equal, and the average value in this zone is used as the calculated value. Simulation data and field record data verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Simplified Modeling Method and Experimental Verification of a Two-Phase Interleaved Three-Level Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A two-phase interleaved three-level boost converter with coupled inductors is designed and analyzed in this paper. With three-level modulation, inductor current ripples are halved, and with coupled configuration plus interleaved operation, the current ripples are further reduced, therefore the size of the inductors can be minimized. However, modeling and analysis of such a converter becomes complicated. To describe the features of the converter in a simple but effective way, the simplified modeling method is proposed in this paper. The operational modes of the converter are first analyzed and the original mathematical model are built; then the model is properly simplified according some assumptions, so that the state-space model and small signal model can be obtained. Both Matlab simulation and experimental prototype are built, and the simulation and experimental results verify the validity of the simplified modeling method.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Control of Active Distribution Network Based on ADMM for Grid-connected Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of distributed generation with high penetration rate into the distribution network, the inherent uncertainty of new energy will affect the operation of the distribution network. Therefore, active distribution network reactive power control suitable for large- scale grid connection of new energy is carried out research can better improve the operation level of the distribution network. Based on the alternating direction multiplier method, this paper takes the minimum objective function value that integrates the total voltage deviation of the node, the network loss and the new energy curtailment power as the optimization objective, and uses the power flow constraint and the safe operation constraint as the constraint conditions to construct a distributed system. The reactive power optimization model is transformed into a convex optimization model by using the second-order cone relaxation technology. The simulation calculation is carried out in the modified IEEE 33-node example system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed new reactive power control model.

articleTitle: Vibration Modeling and Analysis of Power Transformer Core Loosening Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To monitor the operating conditions of power transformers in real-time and predict the loosening faults of the transformers, the finite element simulation software is used to model the transformer, to simulate the vibration of the transformer core under different compressive stresses during its operation, and to analyze the vibration signal in this paper. Firstly, the transformer is modeled, and the electromagnetic field distribution of the transformer is solved through field-circuit coupling. Then, the force condition and vibration displacement distribution of the transformer are solved through the coupling of the electromagnetic field and structural force field. Finally, the simulation results of normal and fault conditions are compared, and the vibration characteristics of fault conditions are obtained. The experimental results show that the high order harmonic components in the vibration acceleration spectrogram increase significantly when the transformer core has a loosening fault, among which the 600Hz harmonic component increases the most.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Calculation Analysis of Very Fast Transient Overvoltage Arcing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In gas insulated substation (GIS), very fast transient over-voltage (VFTO) is caused during the switching operation because of repeated arc reignition. At present only the first arc is considered for numerical simulation of VFTO, which can’t describe the character of VFTO exactly, because the time of arc reignition and extinction is difficult to determine. Base on arc dynamic energy equation, the paper confirms the decision condition of arc reignition and extinction, and gets VFTO wave and peak voltage of each node during arc reignition by simulating. Comparing to the two results, it could see that, for the same node, there was not great change in wave forms; the VFTO maximums both on mains side of switching, also this node’s peak voltage had the largest difference, base on the first arc peak voltage, approximately 10.78%, which should been attention to for insulation of apparatus.

articleTitle: Differential Lightning Protection Analysis of 10kV Distribution Line Under Different Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The level of insulation of 10kV rural distribution lines is relatively low, resulting in a significant increase in the incidence of lightning accidents. The rural terrain is complex, and the use of the same lightning protection standard is not safe. Lightning protection research on three working conditions in the background of rural distribution lines. Using the ATP-EMTP software, based on the inductive thunder and direct lightning model, the effects of various lightning protection measures on rural distribution lines were analyzed. The results show that under different conditions, differentiated lightning protection measures have significantly improved the lightning withstand level of distribution line.

articleTitle: Political Optimizer based Maximum Power Harvesting Technique for Offshore PMSG
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Permanent magnetic synchronous generator (PMSG) plays as one of the major generator types applied in offshore wind farms thanks to its low costs and simple structure. In general, PMSG usually suffers faster and severer time-varying operation condition compared to that of onshore alternatives. As a result, maximum power point tracking (MPPT) for offshore PMSG system becomes a very crucial issue to harvest the possible highest wind energy. Basically, several coupled PI loops are used in PMSG, by which the gain tuning is undertaken through trial-and-error, thus the optimality cannot be guaranteed while significant tuning time is also required. In order to handle this difficulty, this work utilizes a new developed political optimizer to optimally tune these PI gains under two typical cases studies, e.g., (a) step change of wind speed and (b) random wind speed, upon which the highest wind energy is able to be obtained at different wind speeds. Experimental results from Matlab/Simulink validate the reliability and superiority of PO compared against other well-known algorithms including genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO).

articleTitle: Magnetic Saturation Model-based Sensorless Control of Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) has low cost, simple structure and high efficiency without rotor loss. However the magnetic saturation of the SynRM is serious, and its inductances in d-q axis change nonlinearly with the currents in d-q axis. For this reason, experimental method was used to measure the relationship between inductance and current, and a magnetic saturation model of the SynRM was constructed without detailed size parameters of motor. A sensorless control system of the SynRM was realized based on the model reference adaptive system. Simulation and experiment results show that the system can accurately estimate the motor speed and rotor position with good static and dynamic performance, and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of State Self-sensing Transmission Assets
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The reliability of transmission equipment is an important factor affecting the normal operation of overhead transmission lines. Especially in the scenario of transmission tower Internet of Things (IoT), how to evaluate the reliability of transmission equipment based on massive self-sensing real-time data has become the focus of research. This paper starts from the insulator leakage current sensor and tower stress sensor installed on 110-500kV transmission tower. Based on historical data, MATLAB software is used to study the wavelet analysis model for input signals. Combined with the extreme value risk equation, the probability of transmission equipment failure in the future is analyzed. On this basis, the analytic hierarchy process and the fault probability determination method based on extreme risk are used to determine the reliability of equipment. The research results are of great significance for the timely evaluation of equipment reliability of transmission towers, thereby reducing the operation and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Topology Design of Axial Split Phase Permanent Magnet Fault Tolerant Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper an axial split phase permanent magnet fault tolerant motor (ASP-PMFTM) with high fault tolerant capability is proposed. The phase-stators of the proposed ASP-PMFTM independently distributes along axial direction, which realized superior magnetic, thermal and physical isolation between phases. In circumferential direction, each phase-stator is further divided into two phase units, and the total motor is supplied by two three-phase four-leg inverters. The proposed ASP-PMFTM has high fault tolerant capability, which can address the open circuit fault and short circuit fault simultaneously. Due to the flexible structure of the proposed ASP-PMFTM, the influence of different topologies on the torque output capability and temperature distribution is investigated under both open circuit fault and short circuit fault condition. Finally, the most suitable topology of the propose ASP-PMFTM that can achieve high fault tolerance of both open circuit and short circuit faults is obtained.

articleTitle: An Open-loop Current Injection Method Based on Interleaved DC-DC Converter for Fuel Cell Electrochemical Impedance spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurement is an important method to diagnose the health status of the fuel cell stacks (FCS). So, how to take the EIS measurement more easily and efficiently is a meaningful research point. At present, the main EIS technique of fuel cells is to inject AC signals into the fuel cell stacks by DC/DC converter, but most of the existing schemes are complicated in the topology structure or controller design. Therefore, in order to reduce the complexity of the hardware and controller, this paper proposes an open-loop current injection method based on the interleaved DC-DC converter floating on the high-voltage side. With open-loop AC injection based on the idea of small-signal perturbations, only one voltage controller is needed to be designed, which is very simple in topology and control scheme. In addition, to satisfy the measurement accuracy, the amplitude of the injected AC duty cycle can be adjusted adaptively according to the frequency of the injected signals, thus keeping the amplitude of the input current of the DC-DC converter approximately 10 amperes. In the proposed control method, only one PI controller is used to stable the floating dc side voltage so that produces a DC bias duty cycle, and the amplitude of the injected AC duty cycle signal was adjusted adaptively by the theoretical calculation based on the AC equivalent circuit. Then, A simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the feasibility and performance of the proposed scheme. From the simulation results, not only the whole control and structure is simple and effective, but also the AC injection current has low harmonics at high frequency, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Multi-time Scale Joint Online SOC&SOH Estimation Method for Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to effectively monitor the operating status and health of the single battery in the distributed energy storage system, timely issue early warning information of failures and provide decision-making basis for operation, inspection and maintenance, this paper proposes a joint online estimation method of single battery state of charge(SOC) and state of health(SOH). First, the second-order circuit model of battery is used to construct state space model. Second, the constructed battery state space model is discretized, so a multi-time-scale SOC&SOH joint online estimation method based on the combination of a short-time-scale state filter and a longer-time-scale parameter filter is proposed. Finally, it is verified by simulation that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Multi-Level District Topology Identification Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To locate electrical topology anomalies, multi-level district topology identification method based on voltage, current and power factor of user electric energy data acquiring system is proposed. The method is a comprehensive application of voltage correlation analysis method based on Pearson correlation coefficient analysis, power balance analysis method based on multiple linear regression and line impedance analysis method. In order to give full play to the advantages of each method, voltage analysis correlation method is mainly used to judge the relationship between electricity meter box and electricity meter, power balance analysis method and line impedance analysis method are used to judge the relationship between electricity meter box and transformer. Using multilevel district topology identification method, the correct topology from transformer to electricity meter box and meter can be obtained. Finally, through the analysis and calculation of a actual case, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: A Customer Baseline Measurement Method for Residential User of Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: One of the most important challenges for demand response revenue is the calculation of customer baseline load. In this paper a novel Customer Baseline Load calculation method and it’s correction based on error evaluation is proposed theoretically and empirically. A dataset consisting of 2135 residential customers from China is utilized for the case study to test the performance of the algorithm in actual conditions using accuracy and bias metrics. The case study results show that load data is non-stationary, and the baseline method of grey theory can well adapt to this feature. The model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of demand response load baseline measurement. The average error is decreased from 6.09% to 3.56%. At the same time, it can also provide data support for adjustable load to participate in market-oriented transactions.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Core Temperature Calculation of 110kV Cable Based on Simplified Thermal Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a simplified transient thermal circuit model is proposed, and the error between the core temperature calculated by complete thermal circuit model and that by its simplified model are computed theoretically. Meanwhile, the finite element simulation model of cables is established to obtain the dynamic core temperature. Then the comparative analysis on the errors between the core temperatures calculated by the simplified model and the simulation temperatures. Analysis results show that the errors between the core temperatures calculated by simplified model and the simulation temperatures are inside the allowable range, thus in engineering application the simplified thermal circuit model can be used to calculate the core temperature of the cable by the outer sheath temperature.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling Technology and Optimization Method of Metro Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Due to the differences of subway train running interval in time scale and space scale, the load of subway power supply network is not evenly distributed in time and space, which results in the unbalanced load of power supply network lines and main transformers, reducing the reliability of power supply network. By analyzing the structure of subway power supply network, this paper firstly establishes the station load model based on the train timetable and then based on this station load model, a multi-objective optimization model was constructed with the objective function of minimizing weighted network loss, voltage drop and load unbalance, and the power supply network reconfiguration was realized by switching and switching operation. Finally, the optimization model proposed in this paper is verified and analyzed by a subway power supply network.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Ultrasound Induced by Partial Discharge in Power Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: When the discharge occurs, charged particles and neutral particles collide. In the process of collision, the interaction between charged and neutral particles in the ionized gas leads to a perturbation of the surrounding air, which generate ultrasound. In the case of voids in the cable insulation, repeated partial discharge is one of the main sources of insulation degradation, which may lead to a complete breakdown of the insulation. Therefore, it is important to monitor the condition of cable insulation through partial discharge measurement. In this paper, a cable simulation model is established in order to study the propagation and attenuation characteristics of ultrasound generated by partial discharge. This cable model has a built-in optical fiber that can be used to monitor partial discharges. The results show that the attenuation of ultrasound from XLPE insulation layer to the fiber core is 58dB-64dB.

articleTitle: Design of a Multiple Current Transformer System with Adaptive Power Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the CT power-supply for the monitoring devices such as smart gateways. To ensure the stability and the reliability of the monitoring equipment, this paper proposes a multiple CT system with adaptive power control, which can solve the problem of unstable power supply resulting from the fluctuant current on the high-voltage transmission line. The proposed system can adaptively adjust the number of power transformer circuits according to the amplitude of the current on the high-voltage cable. Hence, the output power can always meet the load demand, which ensures the normal operation of the smart gateway.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Motor Bearing Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the fault diagnosis effect of motor bearing fault is poor when the effective data samples are insufficient under variable working conditions, a motor bearing fault diagnosis method based on deep migration learning is proposed. Firstly, the fault mechanism of motor bearing is analyzed, and the collected original vibration signal is transformed by SVD denoising wavelet packet transform to obtain a color two-dimensional time-frequency map conducive to the training of convolutional neural network; Secondly, the network is constructed, the structure and parameters are determined through training, and the over fitting is suppressed by data enhancement and dropout mechanism; Finally, transfer learning is introduced to freeze the trained network bottom structure, and fine tune the network top structure with small sample data under different working conditions. The example analysis shows that the introduction of transfer learning can realize the accurate classification of small samples under other working conditions, and solve the problem of poor fault diagnosis effect when there are insufficient samples in practical engineering application.

articleTitle: State Identification of Transformers under DC Bias Based on Nonlinear Vibration Feature
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Power transformers under DC bias means that there is a DC component in the magnetic flux, which has an important impact on the vibration of transformer. In this paper, the mechanism of the transformer vibration caused by magnetic DC bias is reviewed. Next, a feature extraction method based on vibration mutual information is proposed, and a neutral point current prediction model based on the extreme learning machine (ELM) algorithm is also established. Finally, the experiments are conducted to verify the feature extraction method, and the neutral point current prediction model is trained and tested. The results show that the extracted nonlinear vibration feature combined with the ELM method can identify the transformer state under DC bias.

articleTitle: Short Circuit Impedance Analysis for Cross-Coupling AT Power Traction Network Under Over-zone Feeding Operation Condition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The cross-coupling AT (Autotransformer) power supply mode is applied to high-speed railways in China. When the power failure of traction substation is caused by the incoming power supply or equipment failure, the traction network needs to adopt the over-zone feeding operation condition to ensure the continuous power supply. It is necessary to analyze the short circuit impedance of traction network under over-zone feeding operation condition. It provides a useful reference for the analysis of relay protection and power supply capacity of the traction network. In this paper, the equivalent circuit method is used to build the circuit model of cross-coupling AT power traction network under over-zone feeding operation condition, and the relationship between short circuit impedance and distance is deduced. The relation characteristics of short circuit impedance and distance is explained. The improvement of distance protection setting under the existing over-zone feeding operation condition. is proposed. The simulation result based on Matlab/Simulink shows that the application of equivalent circuits and the derivation of short circuit impedance formula are verified.

articleTitle: Research on Contact Wire Uplift of Typical High-speed Railway at 300km/h and 350km/h
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: For analysis of distribution rules on contact wire uplift of high-speed railway, the data of continuous contact wire uplift of typical high-speed railway at the speed of 300km/h and 350km/h was calculated and analyzed. The analysis results show that the contact wire uplift is positively correlated with the speed of the train. The uplift in the span is higher than the uplift at the registration point, besides, the contact wire uplift in the overlap and in the tunnel is relatively high. The inspection data calculation method and analysis results can provide effective data for the analysis and evaluation of the dynamic performance of the catenary, thereby infrastructure manager can more comprehensively grasp the operating status, and provide reasonable guiding proposals for operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Composite Insulator Decay Defect Detection Based on Nature Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In the operation of composite insulators, once there is a disconnection fault, it will cause a vicious accident of disconnection, which will seriously affect the normal operation of the power grid. In recent years, there has been a phenomenon of decay and fracture of composite insulators, which is different from brittle fracture and conventional fracture. At present, the domestic and foreign countries are still in the preliminary stage of research on the decay and fracture of the mandrel, and it is very important to explore a method for detecting the decay state of composite insulators. Based on the characteristics of composite insulator decay and fracture, this paper simulates and analyzes the effect of decay degree on the low-order natural frequency of composite insulators, and explores the feasibility of the detection method of composite insulator decay defects based on low-order natural frequencies. The simulation results show that the decay of the composite insulator causes its low-order natural frequency to shift, and the degree of shift increases with the increase of decay depth and length, which proves that it is feasible to use natural frequency deviation of composite insulators to detect decayed composite insulators.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation Path Analysis of Typical District Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the development of global warming, environmental degradation and energy crisis, a new round of energy revolution has been set off all over the world. District energy internet comes into being with this opportunity, which aims to promote the consumption of renewable energy, and improve the efficiency of multi-energy utilization. In this paper, a typical district classification method based on Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) model is proposed, which divides typical districts into six types. According to the characteristics of different types of districts, implementation routes of Energy Internet development are planned. Last but not least, case studies of several district energy internet are analyzed as well.

articleTitle: A New Simple and Low Cost Short Circuit Protection Method for p-GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The short circuit capability of gallium nitride high electron mobility transistor (GaN HEMT) exhibits great differences under different drain-source voltages, thus its short circuit protection is critical for practical applications. This paper proposes a new short circuit protection method designed for p-GaN HEMTs, which is based on the detection of gate voltage during on-state of the devices. The short circuit capability and the unique gate characteristics for p-GaN during short circuit fault are illustrated, and the principle of the proposed short circuit protection method is analyzed in detail. The experimental results show that the proposed method can detect the short circuit within 620ns and turn off the GaN devices within 140ns. Compared with conventional desaturation protection, the scheme in this paper offers benefits in terms of low costs, temperature advantage, flexibility in threshold selection and minimal impact on the normal switching behavior.

articleTitle: Optimal design of capacitance core thickness of 500kV GOE bushing based on electric field simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the development of country economy, the demand for reliability of power supply is gradually increasing. The insulation performance of high-voltage bushing is widely concerned as one of the main components of transformer. In this paper, aiming at improving the performance of the 500 kV GOE oil-immersed bushing, the electric field simulation model of the bushing is established by using the finite element method. The bushing electric field distribution under certain conditions is analyzed, considering the influence of the capacitance plate thickness on the electric field distribution in the core, and the electric field distribution intensity on the surface of shield electrode under different electrode radius and ascending flanged base diameter. As a reference standard, the maximum field-strength of the bushing is extracted. And following the standard, the structure of shield electrode is optimized by combining the influence of the thickness of the capacitor core plate and the radius of the shield electrode on the field-strength. The results have guiding significance for engineering application.

articleTitle: Flashover Characteristics of Insulating Stick with Hydrophobic Coatings under Artificial Rain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to enhance the insulation performance of insulating stick under the condition of short-time rainfall and high humidity. The flashover characteristics of insulating stick with hydrophobic coatings under artificial rain was investigated. The hydrophobicity, leakage current and surface discharge voltage of three kinds of insulating sticks samples were tested and analyzed. And combined with image recognition technology to analyze the morphological distribution of water droplets on different surfaces. The test results show that the hydrophobicity of insulating sticks coated with hydrophobic coating increased under dry condition, the dry flashover voltage of the three different insulator cover samples has little difference and the difference is less than 5%; under rain condition, the wet flashover voltage of P-El88 coating were more than 75% higher than that of the uncoated sample, and the leakage current is about 1/9 of that of the uncoated sample. The analysis of image recognition technology shows that the duty cycle and particle size of water droplets on the hydrophobic coating surface are smaller than those on the uncoated. The duty ratio and particle size of water droplets on hydrophobic coating surface are smaller than those on uncoated.

articleTitle: Grounding Impedance Measurement Equipment for Lightning Protection System Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 2nd China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Currently, impedance measurement equipment is usually implemented with monolithic frequency small signal sinusoidal excitation method. In special geographical conditions where deep grounding structure is not possible, grounding rods with complex impedance characteristics are usually deployed. To precisely measure such impedance, high current excitation and full digital control have to be implemented. This paper proposed a new type of intelligent ground impedance measurement system with high current output capacity and wireless data transmission function.
